_text:
Public Health Engineering Dept, Odisha
Office of the Executive Engineer · Odisha · IN
No. CC/23/2024/017
Dated: 31/03/2026
CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK
This is to certify that the work of “Sewerage Network — Odisha Pkg-17” (sewerage drainage),
awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) ,
has been completed in all respects on 27/03/2024 at a gross executed value of Rs. 3854.00 Lakh
(Rupees 38.54 Crore Only).
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on
satisfactory completion of the final inspection.
The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Meera Roy. This certificate is issued for record
and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past
performance.
Executive Engineer
Public Health Engineering Dept, Odisha
